authorization.requires: Fresh explicit owner authorization for the named arms, compute budget and synthetic-dataset generation before any run; the 2.00 CU V2 campaign ledger is not reused or reset.

arms.ZERO_SHOT_UNCONSTRAINED: Pinned SmolLM3, V3 prompt and native xml_tools, greedy generation under the profile decoding bounds. Measures syntax plus intent.
arms.ZERO_SHOT_CONSTRAINED: Pinned SmolLM3, same prompt, scripts/a02_v3_constrained.py grammar walk. Syntax control: removes format failure, isolates choice quality.
arms.ADAPTED_UNCONSTRAINED: Supervised-adapted candidate, native generation as in the first arm.
arms.ADAPTED_CONSTRAINED: Supervised-adapted candidate under the same grammar walk.
arms.STRONGER_MODEL_ZERO_SHOT: Optional; only if the rule escalates. Requires a separate preregistration naming the model.

adaptation.method: LoRA supervised fine-tuning on target_text tokens only (loss masked on prompt tokens); prompt rendered with the V3 action prompt and xml_tools exactly as at evaluation
adaptation.model_selection: No checkpoint selection on held-out data; the final checkpoint after the fixed schedule is evaluated once.

data.rights: Fully synthetic, generated by repository code; no external, empirical, RES-407 protected or RES-424 formal data.

heldout_evaluation.role: Sole decision input; never trained on or used for selection.

exposed_development_cases.role: DEVELOPMENT_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: reported per arm on every axis, including executor and final grounding; never training data, never held-out evidence, never a decision input.

metrics.primary: Exact V3 intent on the held-out set (strict parse and normalized equality with spec gold).
secondary: operation selection where gold names one
exposed_diagnostics_only: raw final grounding under the fixed rule

statistics.method: Paired percentile bootstrap at item level and with whole templates resampled as clusters; the smaller lower bound governs
statistics.cluster_unit: generator template_id; examples sharing a template are correlated

decision_rule.stage_1_meaning: Stage 1 observes only the zero-shot arms. Failing the sufficiency rule makes an adaptation experiment eligible for separate authorization; it is not evidence that adaptation would help.

adaptation_benefit.requires: Observed ADAPTED_CONSTRAINED records bound to the same held-out examples.

decision_rule.evidence_binding: scripts/a02_v3_decision.py::bind_arm: exact preregistered example ids in order; no duplicates, gaps or extras; family, request hash, arm, decoder, model revision, profile and protocol hashes; raw-output hash; correctness recomputed from raw output
reported_not_credited: decoder_condition_exact_gap (includes constrained-search and selection effects, not syntax alone)

compute_estimate.input_sources: Preflight (pinned tokenizer, V3 profile): max prompt 1,508 tokens, max gold-path cached fed tokens 1,932, max scorer calls 69, action cap 128. Session 004 T4 FP16: max steady first-token latency 0.41 s, min steady decode 23.05 tokens/s, 77.7 s pre-generation overhead plus a 35.6 s model load rounded to 113 s.
compute_estimate.consequence: Both zero-shot arms need about 46 minutes (2,735.7 s) of T4 time: more than one 900 s session, so any run needs a budget sized for it. Exposed-case diagnostics add 10 examples per arm. The adapted arms add training time, which is not estimated here because no training is authorized.
compute_estimate.scorer: Constrained arms use CachedSequenceLogprob with HFIncrementalBackend. Uncached full re-scoring would need up to 68,703 scored tokens per example instead of 1,932.

in_run_qualification: Before any arm result counts: score every option on the first 3 held-out examples with both the cached and the uncached reference binding; abort the run if any option differs by more than 1e-3 nats or the chosen action differs.
Verify the pinned model and tokenizer revisions and file hashes, and that rendered prompts reproduce the CPU preflight hashes.
Record raw generations, token ids and per-option scores for every example; score on CPU with scripts/a02_v3_score.py and scripts/a02_v3_decision.py only.

amendments.change: Contract V3.1 (question precedence). Two families added (QUESTION_ADDS_PRACTICAL, QUESTION_ADDS_CAUSAL), both critical; training 2,800 and held-out 280 examples (20 per family); manifests and profile hash re-pinned; compute estimate recomputed for 280 examples.
amendments.reason: Independent review #5824688227 P0 on objective/question precedence.

amendments.change: Arm records are bound to exact preregistered example identity, family, request hash and model, profile and protocol provenance, with correctness recomputed from raw output. The syntax-gap label is replaced by a strict-parse gap and a decoder-condition gap, neither credited. Template-clustered bootstrap is added and governs when more conservative, with per-family Wilson intervals. Stage 1 concludes only adoption or eligibility for an adaptation experiment; benefit needs observed adapted records.
amendments.reason: Independent review #5824688227 P0 evidence integrity, P1 statistics and staged decision.

claim_ceiling: Results bound SmolLM3 behaviour on one synthetic development generator whose train and held-out splits share its 14 intent families. They are not evidence of scientific generalization, real-request safety, or PSE readiness. The ten exposed cases are diagnostics. Summed log-probability selection can favour short options such as NONE or an empty list, so the constrained arm's errors are decoder-and-model choices, not proof of understanding or inability.
